business_summary.text: Horizon Industrial Parks is an Indian industrial and logistics real estate platform with 61 million sq ft across 9 states, 10 markets and 46 assets, serving over 120 customers.

operating_notes.text: Contracted revenue run-rate was ₹967 Cr as of 30 June 2026, with 80-85% from existing assets and the balance from 2.4 million sq ft of pre-leases.
In-place base rent plus CAM is ₹27.20/sq ft; industrial buildings lease above ₹29/sq ft versus about ₹24 for warehousing.
Rooftop solar capacity reached nearly 38 MW, of which about 20 MW is operational and 17-18 MW is being operationalised.
Executed 2.5 mn sq ft of leases in Q2FY27, reaching 4.4 mn sq ft in H1FY27 (68% of FY27 target).
Delivered 1.8 mn sq ft across 6 buildings in Q2FY27; total H1FY27 completions reached 2.7 mn sq ft.
Deployed ₹2,250 Cr of IPO proceeds toward debt repayment, reducing Net Debt to EV to 15%.
Refinanced ₹635 Cr LRD facility in Q2FY27, cutting interest cost by 71 bps.
H1FY27 pro forma cash PAT reached ₹248 Cr post-deleveraging.

timeline.summary: On 11 September 2026, Horizon Industrial Parks held its first post-IPO earnings call, reporting Q1FY27 revenue of ₹200 Cr (+23% YoY), EBITDA of ₹161 Cr at 80% margin, a net loss of ₹12 Cr, and proforma net debt of ₹2,500 Cr after the ₹4,250 Cr IPO.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹214.99 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹15.34 Cr (includes ₹1.2 Cr from discontinued operations; continuing operations ₹12.73 Cr).
Horizon Industrial Parks reported Q2FY27 revenue of ₹213 Cr (+30% YoY), reduced net debt to ₹2,765 Cr, and crossed ₹1,000 Cr in contracted revenue run rate.

watchlist.response: Did not address the FY26 overrun directly; pointed to Q1FY27 net loss of ₹12 Cr and proforma cash PAT of ₹116 Cr after non-cash depreciation and interest.
